SEA.head: A slightly uphill night for the Kraken
SEA.body: The Rangers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, while Seattle will be without McCann. Seattle has home-ice advantage and gets Fleury back, though. The Kraken’s best way to tip it is keeping dangerous shots away.

NYR.head: Leaning the Rangers’ way
NYR.body: The Rangers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, while Seattle will be without McCann. Seattle has home-ice advantage and gets Fleury back, though. Still, it’s close: the Kraken can make it interesting if they keep dangerous shots away.

story.head: Tolvanen returns to Seattle
paras: The Kraken (9-5-1) beat Calgary 2-1 in overtime on Wednesday, and the Rangers have won two in a row. Going in, the Rangers are third in the Metropolitan (tied for 14th in the NHL) and the Kraken third in the Pacific (tied for 14th).
The Rangers’ record (.559) is about what their chances are worth. The Kraken’s record (.633) is running ahead of what their chances are worth (.455), largely thanks to their finishing.

The Rangers lean on their stars as much as almost anyone (2nd lowest), forecheck as hard as almost anyone (2nd) and get a lot of their shots blocked (32nd). As for the Kraken, they rarely threaten on the penalty kill (32nd) and give up a lot of shots (32nd). They also keep dangerous shots away better than anyone (1st), so the Rangers’ good looks will be harder to come by against them. The Rangers’ power play (8th) could do real damage against the Kraken’s penalty kill (31st).

Adam Fox (2 G / 19 A / 21 P in 17 GP) leads the Rangers in scoring, with seven points in his last five games. Alexis Lafrenière (9 G / 7 A / 16 P in 17 GP) has a team-high nine goals. For the Kraken, Berkly Catton (5 G / 7 A / 12 P in 15 GP) leads the way in scoring, and Frédérick Gaudreau (7 G / 3 A / 10 P in 15 GP) has a team-high seven goals.
Dylan Garand (6-6-1 / .906 SV% in 11 GS) is expected to start for the Rangers, and Joey Daccord (4-3-0 / .889 SV% in 7 GS) for Seattle.
At home, Lane Lambert likes to send Nyman, Meyers and Winterton out against opponents’ fourth lines, so watch for them against Chmelař, Laba and Rempe.

items.text: Eeli Tolvanen faces Seattle for the first time since leaving.
The Rangers are newly without Sean Durzi, and have been without Matthew Robertson for several games.
The Kraken have been without Jared McCann since Oct 22.
Mackie Samoskevich has six goals on chances worth about 2.5 goals, well above what his finishing usually turns chances into. Runs like that tend to cool off.
